duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I perform ruqya (healing prayer) upon you from everything that harms you
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi arqika min kulli shay'in yu'dhika

duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. I rely upon Him
duas.transliteration: Hasbi Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.english: All praise is due to Allah by whose favor good deeds are completed
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi bi ni'matihi tatimmu as-salihat

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytani ar-rajim

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and turn to me in mercy. Indeed, You are the Ever-Returning, the Merciful
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa tub 'alayya innaka anta at-Tawwabu ar-Rahim

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
duas.english: My Lord, expand for me my chest and ease for me my task
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
duas.english: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fi ad-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati hasanatan

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا
duas.english: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, grant me righteous offspring
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min as-salihin

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-huda wa at-tuqa wa al-'afafa wa al-ghina

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ
duas.english: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta as-Salam wa minka as-salam

duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma

duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.english: In Your Name, O Allah, I die and I live
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni aslamtu nafsi ilayka

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.english: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadaka

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhi an-nushur

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا
duas.english: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي
duas.english: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, and teach me what will benefit me
duas.transliteration: Allahumma infa'ni bima 'allamtani wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for her goodness and the goodness upon which You have created her
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayriha wa khayri ma jabaltaha 'alayh

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-hammi wa al-hazan

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from weakness and laziness
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-'ajzi wa al-kasal

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.english: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ikfini bi halalika 'an haramika wa aghnini bi fadlika 'amman siwak

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and heavy debt
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-ma'thami wa al-maghram

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
duas.english: Glory is to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts
duas.transliteration: Subhana alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin

duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.english: We are returning, repenting, worshipping our Lord and praising Him
duas.transliteration: Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna li rabbina hamidun

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.english: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud
duas.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى بَرَكَةِ اللَّهِ
duas.english: In the name of Allah and with the blessings of Allah
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi wa 'ala barakatillah

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.english: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small
duas.transliteration: Rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayanî saghira

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytani ar-rajim

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for the best entering and the best exiting
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra al-mawliji wa khayra al-makhraji

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'ala Allah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me
duas.transliteration: Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the hardship and heal, You are the Healer
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabba an-nasi adhhib al-ba'sa ishfi anta ash-Shafi

duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.english: Never mind, may it be a purification, if Allah wills
duas.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in sha' Allah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
duas.english: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him
duas.transliteration: Allahu Allahu Rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'a

duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.english: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum bi rahmatika astaghith

duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs
duas.transliteration: Hasbuna Allahu wa ni'ma al-wakil

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْوَحْشَةِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from loneliness
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-wahshah

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bi kalimat Allahi at-tammati min sharri ma khalaq

duas.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ
duas.english: I seek protection for you in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous pest
duas.transliteration: U'idhu kuma bi kalimat Allahi at-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah

duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ
duas.english: May Allah bless you with His gift to you
duas.transliteration: Baraka Allahu laka fi al-mawhubi lak

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and Your power by Your might
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi 'ilmika wa astaqdiruka bi qudratik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.english: O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbu al-'afwa fa'fu 'anni

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ
duas.english: Glory is to Him Whom thunder and angels glorify due to fear of Him
duas.transliteration: Subhana alladhi yusabbihu ar-ra'du bi hamdihi

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil and evil deeds
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-khubuthi wa al-khaba'ith

duas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
duas.english: I seek Your forgiveness
duas.transliteration: Ghufranaka

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
duas.english: O Allah, as You have made my external features beautiful, make my character beautiful as well
duas.transliteration: Allahumma kama hassanta khalqi fa hassin khuluqi

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah who has clothed me with this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.english: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills
duas.transliteration: Dhahaba adh-dhama'u wa ibtalat al-'uruqu wa thabata al-ajru in sha' Allah

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, He has no partner, His is the dominion and to Him is all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu yuhyi wa yumit wa huwa hayyun la yamut

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You
duas.transliteration: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the means and superiority
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabba hadhihi ad-da'wati at-tammati wa as-salati al-qa'imati ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wa al-fadilah

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.english: Glory is to Allah, and all praise is to Allah, and Allah is the Greatest
duas.transliteration: Subhana Allah wa alhamdu lillah wa Allahu akbar

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give thanks to You, and to worship You in the best manner
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ
duas.english: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, and pardon me among those You have pardoned
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ihdini fiman hadayta wa 'afini fiman 'afayt

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي
duas.english: O Allah, make the Quran the spring of my heart
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'al al-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ
duas.english: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ighfir lahu wa irhamhu

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ
duas.english: O Allah, pardon him, have mercy on him, and honor his reception
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'afihi wa'fu 'anhu wa akrim nuzulah

duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
duas.english: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.english: O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ujurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah by whose favor good deeds are completed
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi bi ni'matihi tatimmu as-salihat

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah in all circumstances
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty and Your mercy
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlika wa rahmatik

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً
duas.english: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
duas.english: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fi ad-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati hasanatan

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكِبْرِ وَالْعُجْبِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from arrogance and vanity
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-kibri wa al-'ujb

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an ushrika bika shay'an wa ana a'lam

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا
duas.english: O Allah, bless us in what You have provided for us
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fima razaqtana

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِي
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my hearing and the evil of my sight
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri sam'i wa min sharri basari

duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.english: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm on Your religion
duas.transliteration: Ya Muqallib al-qulub thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ
duas.english: O Allah, we place You before them
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim

duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.english: I seek forgiveness from Allah, there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him
duas.transliteration: Astaghfiru Allah alladhi la ilaha illa Huwa al-Hayy al-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh

duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ
duas.english: We have entered evening and the dominion belongs to Allah
duas.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsa al-mulku lillah

duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ
duas.english: We have entered morning and the dominion belongs to Allah
duas.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbaha al-mulku lillah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from helplessness, laziness and cowardice
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-'ajzi wa al-kasali wa al-jubni

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
duas.english: O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who are purified
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'alni min at-tawwabin wa ij'alni min al-mutatahhirin

duas.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
duas.english: Indeed, with hardship comes ease
duas.transliteration: Inna ma'a al-'usri yusra

duas.arabic: قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
duas.english: It is the decree of Allah, and what He wills, He does
duas.transliteration: Qadaru Allahi wa ma sha'a fa'al

duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
duas.english: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbi al-Falaq

duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
duas.english: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbi an-Nas

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا
duas.english: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us
duas.transliteration: Subhana alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَقَانَا عَذْبًا فُرَاتًا بِرَحْمَتِهِ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah who gave us sweet, refreshing water to drink by His mercy
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi saqana 'adhban furatan bi rahmatihi

duas.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
duas.english: May Allah reward you with goodness
duas.transliteration: Jazaka Allahu khayra

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillah

duas.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
duas.english: May Allah have mercy on you
duas.transliteration: Yarhamuka Allah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
duas.english: O Allah, do not take me to account for what they say
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la tu'akhidhni bima yaqulun

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah who has spared me what He has afflicted you with
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi 'afani mimma ibtalaka bihi

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مَجْلِسِ السُّوءِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from bad company
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min majlisi as-su'

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
duas.english: O Allah, bless it for us and increase it for us
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa zidna minhu

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا
duas.english: O Allah, bless my nation in their early mornings
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik li ummati fi bukuriha

duas.arabic: مَا خَابَ مَنِ اسْتَخَارَ وَلَا نَدِمَ مَنِ اسْتَشَارَ
duas.english: He who makes istikhara will not fail, and he who seeks counsel will not regret
duas.transliteration: Ma khaba man istakhara wa la nadima man istashara

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْمَعْ بَيْنَنَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.english: O Allah, unite us in goodness
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ijma' baynana fi khayr

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that does not have humility
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min qalbin la yakhsha'

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, He has no partner
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-jannata wa a'udhu bika min an-nar

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni 'abduka ibnu 'abdika ibnu amatika nasiyati biyadik

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.english: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate
duas.transliteration: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khayru al-munzilin

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin wa ij'alna lil-muttaqina imama

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-'afiyata fi ad-dunya wa al-akhirah

duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي
duas.english: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un Allahumma ujurni fi musibati

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ عَمَلٍ لَا يُرْفَعُ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit and from deeds that are not raised
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa'u wa min 'amalin la yurfa'

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabba an-nasi adhhib al-ba'sa ishfi wa anta ash-Shafi la shifa'a illa shifa'uk

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الظُّلْمِ وَالْمَظْلَمَةِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from oppression and being oppressed
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min adh-dhulmi wa al-madhlamah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِهِ رَحْمَةً وَعَفْوًا
duas.english: O Allah, place mercy and pardon in their heart
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'al fi qalbihi rahmatan wa 'afwa

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith
duas.transliteration: Rabbana ighfir lana wa li-ikhwanina alladhina sabaquna bi al-iman

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
duas.english: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni dhalamtu nafsi faghfir li

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-huda wa at-tuqa wa al-'afafa wa al-ghina

duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs, the best Protector and the best Helper
duas.transliteration: Hasbuna Allahu wa ni'ma al-wakil ni'ma al-mawla wa ni'ma an-nasir

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ خِرْ لِي وَاخْتَرْ لِي
duas.english: O Allah, choose what is best for me and make the choice for me
duas.transliteration: Allahumma khir li wakhtir li
